title: Custom view provider is lazy-loaded on the chat-session route because of ESM-only @a2ui
answers: why is ExperimentCustomViewProvider lazy loaded in sessions page
a2ui ESM error in chat session route
custom view provider React.lazy import sessions
body:
ExperimentSingleChatSessionPage.tsx imports ExperimentCustomViewProvider through React.lazy and wraps it in React.Suspense, with a comment that the custom view pulls in @a2ui (ESM-only) transitively.
The lazy import keeps @a2ui out of the chat-session route graph unless custom views are enabled.
Do not replace this with a static import of ExperimentCustomViewProvider in this page; that would pull @a2ui into the route unconditionally.
The Suspense fallback is a GenericSkeleton sized to flex: 1 with margin 16.
applies: Chat-session page and any other route bundle that needs the custom view provider; applies to static-import changes in that page.
says: Opening an experiment chat session page crashes with a script error.
The chat session screen should load cleanly without pulling in unused custom views.
Chat session history fails to render when custom view extensions are bundled.
Show a loading placeholder skeleton while custom experiment views are loading.
search: ExperimentSingleChatSessionPage.tsx must lazy-load ExperimentCustomViewProvider using React.lazy and React.Suspense with a GenericSkeleton fallback to isolate the transitive ESM-only @a2ui dependency. A static import must not be used because it pulls @a2ui unconditionally into the chat-session route bundle. Applies to the chat-session page and any route bundle needing the custom view provider.
